app.UHVzaG92ZXI.desc.source: Pushover makes it easy to get real-time notifications on your Android, iPhone, iPad, and Desktop. Send notifications for urgent alerts, system monitoring, or any automated messaging needs.

app.UHVzaG92ZXI.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Make a custom API call to Pushover

app.UHVzaG92ZXI.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Pushover** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
